latest_release.name: v1.7.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Stop the run after finish_pr_review by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1451
* Stop false "ended without calling finish_scan" error on PR reviews by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1449
* feat(cli): add -r and a title column to the resume picker by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1450
* feat(tui): set the terminal title to the scan target by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1479
* fix(logging): suppress Agents SDK PTY warning that interferes with TUI by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1392
* feat(llm): detect whether a model accepts image input by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1460
* feat(llm): keep images away from text-only models by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1465
* feat(llm): scrub images from every request to a text-only model by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1466
* fix(execution): only strip images on image-rejection errors by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1461
* feat(llm): log the upstream provider behind OpenRouter by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1459
* feat(llm): retry 4xx model errors by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1486
* feat(llm): bound the first stream event and the whole stream by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1487
* fix(mcp): load catalogs before agents discover connections by @bearsyankees in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1492
* Let callers choose the top-level agent's finish tool by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1496
* docs(readme): add update instructions by @yoni-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1501
* feat(reporting): accept code_locations on dependency reports by @yoni-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1366
* feat(tui): show the run's targets in a sidebar box by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1500
* fix(proxy): log Caido SDK errors as warnings by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1517
* feat(runtime): add defer=True to create_or_reuse so the agent loop does not wait for the sandbox bring-up by @devin-ai-integration[bot] in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1518
* feat(runtime): accept an awaitable extra_files in create_or_reuse so the sandbox create does not wait for it by @devin-ai-integration[bot] in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1521
* fix(reporting): drop the static-analysis disclaimer from dependency evidence by @yoni-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1520
* test(resume-picker): put the pty in cbreak so the key-reader test can't hang on macOS by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1527
* fix(models): replay malformed tool-call arguments as valid JSON by @bearsyankees in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1327
* feat(llm): extra request-body fields via LLM_EXTRA_BODY by @SzymonNastaly in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1495
* fix(agents): exec_command states the 30 s yield cap and that a running non-TTY process cannot be polled by @devin-ai-integration[bot] in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1535
* fix(core): an operator pause holds under every budget policy and only resume_budget lifts it by @devin-ai-integration[bot] in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1536
* feat(run): STRIX_RUN_RECORD_TIMINGS records every LLM request's and tool call's timing in run.json by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1539
* feat(agents): let callers choose the report tool by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1550
* fix(reporting): keep HTTP exchange evidence when the proxy is slow to… by @bearsyankees in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1551
* build(deps): enforce a 5-day release cooldown for uv and npm resolution by @bearsyankees in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/
